level_1_auto_restart.trigger: Node sleeping or single runtime error
level_1_auto_restart.action: auto_restart.py handles automatically during daily sweep
level_1_auto_restart.escalate_after: 3 consecutive failures in the restart log

level_2_rebuild.trigger: BUILD_ERROR or CONFIG_ERROR persists after 3 restart attempts
level_2_rebuild.action: Inspect space logs, verify template, redeploy the specific node
level_2_rebuild.escalate_after: Template mismatch or persistent dependency error
manual_steps: Check HF space build logs at https://huggingface.co/spaces/<space_id>/logs
If template issue: fix template, then redeploy

level_3_infrastructure.trigger: More than 5 nodes offline simultaneously or HF API returning 5xx errors
level_3_infrastructure.action: Check HF platform status, verify HF_TOKEN validity, review rate limits
level_3_infrastructure.escalate_after: HF platform outage confirmed or token expired
manual_steps: If outage: wait and retry with auto_restart.py --watch

level_4_constitutional.trigger: sigma != 1.0 or L_inf != phi^48 or coherence < 0.777 detected in any node
level_4_constitutional.action: HALT all deployments immediately. Run full compliance audit.
level_4_constitutional.escalate_after: Immediate -- constitutional violations are critical and must be resolved before any further deployment

priority_recalculation.description: Node priorities may be recalculated based on deployment progress and dependency satisfaction

rules.description: If a priority-4+ node is a dependency for a priority-2 node, promote it to priority 3
rules.example: If N085 (Obs-Network-Health, P3) depends on having > 10 nodes live, deploy it as soon as that threshold is met

rules.description: If a group has > 50% of its nodes live, remaining nodes in that group get priority reduced by 1 (higher urgency)
rules.example: A_COMMAND has 2/12 live. Once 7/12 are live, remaining 5 nodes drop from their current priority to priority-1 lower

rules.description: L_SYNTHESIS nodes (N133-N144) require >= 80% of network live before deployment
rules.example: Even if N133 is priority 3, it should not deploy until >= 115 nodes are live

rules.description: H_OBSERVERS nodes should only deploy after at least 10 nodes are live and producing data
rules.example: N085 (Obs-Network-Health) is most useful when there are nodes to observe
